[LNUL.3.2] **Flow-typed, not boxed.** The runtime value is a plain `null`; the
*compiler* tracks `T?` and refuses to use a `T?` where a `T` is required until
it is narrowed ([LNUL.5]). There is **no `Maybe<T>` tagged union and no
generics** — nothing new to propagate through the Rete network. (This is the
Kotlin/Swift `T?` model, not Rust's `Option<T>`.)
